verdict.rationale: Superset says you can "Run your agents from your phone" and get notified when an agent "pauses for your input", so it plausibly supports remote human-in-the-loop responses. However, nothing documents a mobile approval flow for key decisions, and a paused agent waits for you rather than continuing. Missing for 10: a documented approve/reject action on mobile, detail on how the phone experience handles pending decisions, evidence that agents keep working while approval is pending, and independent hands-on corroboration of mobile use.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can approve key agent decisions from my phone while agents continue working

citations.quote: Run your agents from your phone.
Finished / waiting for input: get notified when an agent finishes or pauses for your input.
